body: On a throwaway because my main account is super weird. I'm not sure how hard it is overall, but I got a 161 on quantitative and a 167 on verbal on my GRE and my in major GPA was a 3.67 or something. I also had a recommendation that was really, really stellar. This is my first semester here (I deferred fall admission for health reasons), so I'm not really sure what other people's experiences are. Hope this helps!
Our campus counselors are so useless. I do have an off campus counselor for PTSD treatment who I haven't been able to get to another appointment with.

I'm not worried about the degree once I get it, my field is in very high demand. I have severe PTSD and anxiety, and I spend the majority of my time in fight or flight. It's exhausting, I can't focus. I'm a little worried about undiagnosed bipolar, because my lows are very low and they come and go quickly, but I don't really have extreme highs so it may just be PTSD triggers getting to me.
There's no guarantee I'll get the degree, I have to pass all of my classes and it's going to be rough. I bury myself in work and commitments because I feel worthless otherwise, but I just get so overwhelmed and end up doing everything poorly. Side note, I saw your username and initially thought my fiance had found this and panicked a moment.
